brief: Holds an in-memory reference vault resolver, the contract between a vault-sourced secret and an external secret manager.
detail: A vault resolver is any object with Resolve(locator), which returns the value or raises, and ideally Has(locator). A secret whose source is a vault is fetched through one, passed at reveal time to RevealVia, so nothing holds a live backend handle. This class satisfies the contract for development and tests: you seed it with values. In production replace it with an object that calls your real vault, such as stzVaultHttpResolver; the secret, the store and the actor gate do not change. Locators are written path#field.
